messages:
alex: heads-up — saw a weird spike in token refresh calls from the mobile SDK during a rolling canary. App moved to background, single user action, but we observed 4 refresh attempts in quick succession.
maria: that rings a bell. do we have repro steps? which os / okhttp / retrofit?
alex: Pixel 7a, Android 14 beta, okhttp 4.11.0, retrofit 2.9.0. reproduces when network blips ~200-400ms and OkHttp cancels/reschedules calls.
sam: log snippet? stack traces?
alex: pasted below (trimmed):

```
I/OkHttp: Call canceled: okhttp3.RealCall$AsyncCall
auth: refresh started account=user:42
I/OkHttp: Call enqueued: okhttp3.RealCall$AsyncCall
auth: refresh started account=user:42
I/OkHttp: Call enqueued: okhttp3.RealCall$AsyncCall
auth: refresh started account=user:42
```

alex: looks like interceptor executed multiple times and kicked off parallel refreshes. we have an in-interceptor mutex but it keys on request.hashCode().

erin: suspending inside interceptors can be tricky. if you create new Call objects on reconnect, the key won't match and dedupe fails. are you using a per-call key?

alex: yes, the mutex was per-call. ci-bot: reproduced in CI on emulator android-14-api-34; test auth/duplicate-refresh-001 failed.

maria: propose an inflight-refresh map keyed by user id/account id at process scope. ensure the refresh future is shared across interceptor invocations.
sam: also ensure token refresh runs off the OkHttp dispatcher — use Dispatchers.IO or a single thread executor so you don't block OkHttp threads.
erin: snippet ive used: 
```
private val inflight = ConcurrentHashMap<String, Deferred<String>>()
fun refreshToken(accountId: String): Deferred<String> = inflight.computeIfAbsent(accountId) {
  CoroutineScope(Dispatchers.IO).async { doRefresh() }.also { d -> d.invokeOnCompletion { inflight.remove(accountId) } }
}
```
maria: small nit: avoid GlobalScope due to lifecycle. inject a dedicated scope or use SupervisorJob tied to process lifetime. also handle cancellation if app is backgrounded and process gets killed.
alex: i'll implement inflight map + dedicated CoroutineScope and add integration test that simulates flaky socket closing after ~250ms to assert single refresh.
sam: add CI test that runs emulator with network toggle to validate. maybe add a flaky okhttp socket factory in unit tests.
ci-bot: linked failure: https://ci.internal/reports/5678 — logs + reproducer attached.
maria: include okhttp version and emulator command in the PR description so other teams can triage.
alex: will open PR in ~45m with tests and notes. thanks folks. :thumbsup:
